<module id="multi_pipe_4bit">
	<description>Design a 4-bit unsigned number pipeline multiplier. It includes two levels of registers to store intermediate values and control the multiplication process.</description>
	
	<ports>
		<input id="clk">Clock signal for synchronous operation.</input>
		<input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal. Set to 0 for chip reset and 1 for reset signal inactive.</input>
		
		<input id="mul_a" width_description="[3:0]">Input signal representing the multiplicand with a data width of 'size' bits.</input>
		<input id="mul_b" width_description="[3:0]">Input signal representing the multiplier with a data width of 'size' bits.</input>
		
		<output id="mul_out" width_description="[7:0]">Product output signal with a data width of 2*size bits.</output>
	end
	
	<parameter_description>
		<parameter id="size">4</parameter>
	end
	
	<implementation>
		<!-- Extend input signals -->
		wire [size*2-1:0] mul_a_ext;
		wire [size*2-1:0] mul_b_ext;
		assign mul_a_ext = {size{1'b0}} | mul_a;
		assign mul_b_ext = {size{1'b0}} | mul_b;
		
		// Generate partial products
		genvar i;
		generate
			for(i = 0; i < size; i=i+1) begin : gen_partial_products
				wire [size*2-1:0] pp;
				if(mul_b[i]) begin
					assign pp = mul_a_ext << i;
				end else begin
					assign pp = 'd0;
				end
			end
		endgenerate
		
		// Add of partial products
		reg [size*2-1:0] regs[0:size-1];
		integer j;
		always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
			if(!rst_n) begin
				for(j = 0; j < size; j=j+1) begin
					regs[j] <= 0;
				end
			end else begin
				for(j = 0; j < size; j=j+1) begin
					regs[j] <= regs[j] + gen_partial_products[j].pp;
				end
			end
		end
		
		// Final product calculation
		reg [size*2-1:0] prod;
		always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
			if(!rst_n) begin
				prod <= 0;
			end else begin
				prod</implementation></parameter_description></ports></module>
